items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Gussie stuck around and played with Bert Kelly. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember him.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was 1915. You'd only been 10 years old. You wouldn't know that.
I think Gussie stuck around and played with Bert Kelly.
